env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/generic_type_arguments.lgo behavior/main.lgo
cp behavior/main.lgo original.lgo.txt
cd behavior
logos run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/generic_type_arguments.out
logos eject -o ../behavior-out
cmp main.lgo ../original.lgo.txt
cd ../behavior-out
grep -count=1 'type-slot-comment' main.go
go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/generic_type_arguments.out
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/generic_type_arguments.out
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1273/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/generic_type_arguments.out

cd ../controls
cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/generic_type_argument_index_controls.lgo main.lgo
logos run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/generic_type_argument_index_controls.out
logos eject -o ../controls-out
cd ../controls-out
go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/generic_type_argument_index_controls.out
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/generic_type_argument_index_controls.out
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1273/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/generic_type_argument_index_controls.out

-- behavior/go.mod --
module example.com/typearguments

go 1.27

-- controls/go.mod --
module example.com/indexcontrols

go 1.27
